mapper.sql: TENANT_ID, STAT, MENU_SCOPE, MENU_CODE, MENU_NAME, MENU_LEVEL, MENU_TYPE, UPP_MENU_CODE, MENU_CHECKED, MENU_KIND, MENU_VERIFY, MENU_DISPLAY, TR_CODE, SECURITY_TR_CODE, CTRL_ATTI, BIZ_ATTI, ACCT_AUTH_ATTI, ASAC_AUTH_ATTI, TIME_ATTI, WORKFLOW_FLAG, WORKFLOW_BIZ_TYPE, IS_ADMIN, IS_OPERATOR, IS_USER, SORT_NO, SUBSYSTEM_CODE, FOLDER_CODE, BIZ_CATEGORY_NO, BIZ_CATEGORY_NAME, MENU_ICON, MENU_HERF_TYPE, MENU_HERF, MENU_ATTRIBUTE, ICON_FLAG, IS_KEEP_ALIVE, JUMP_HERF, TB_VERSION, DESCRIPTION
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT FROM perm_menu WHERE UPP_MENU_CODE = #{uppMenuCode} AND MENU_SCOPE = #{menuScope} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT m.TENANT_ID, m.STAT, m.MENU_SCOPE, m.MENU_CODE, m.MENU_NAME, m.MENU_LEVEL, m.MENU_TYPE, m.UPP_MENU_CODE, m.MENU_CHECKED, m.MENU_KIND, m.MENU_VERIFY, m.MENU_DISPLAY, m.TR_CODE, m.SECURITY_TR_CODE, m.CTRL_ATTI, m.BIZ_ATTI, m.ACCT_AUTH_ATTI, m.ASAC_AUTH_ATTI, m.TIME_ATTI, m.WORKFLOW_FLAG, m.WORKFLOW_BIZ_TYPE, m.IS_ADMIN, m.IS_OPERATOR, m.IS_USER, m.SORT_NO, m.SUBSYSTEM_CODE, m.FOLDER_CODE, m.BIZ_CATEGORY_NO, m.BIZ_CATEGORY_NAME, m.MENU_ICON, m.MENU_HERF_TYPE, m.MENU_HERF, m.MENU_ATTRIBUTE, m.ICON_FLAG, m.IS_KEEP_ALIVE, m.JUMP_HERF, m.TB_VERSION, m.DESCRIPTION FROM perm_menu m INNER JOIN descendants d ON m.UPP_MENU_CODE = d.MENU_CODE AND m.MENU_SCOPE = d.MENU_SCOPE AND m.TENANT_ID = d.TENANT_ID ) SELECT * FROM descendants
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO perm_menu ( TENANT_ID, STAT, MENU_SCOPE, MENU_CODE, MENU_NAME, MENU_LEVEL, MENU_TYPE, UPP_MENU_CODE, MENU_CHECKED, MENU_KIND, MENU_VERIFY, MENU_DISPLAY, TR_CODE, SECURITY_TR_CODE, CTRL_ATTI, BIZ_ATTI, ACCT_AUTH_ATTI, ASAC_AUTH_ATTI, TIME_ATTI, WORKFLOW_FLAG, WORKFLOW_BIZ_TYPE, IS_ADMIN, IS_OPERATOR, IS_USER, SORT_NO, SUBSYSTEM_CODE, FOLDER_CODE, BIZ_CATEGORY_NO, BIZ_CATEGORY_NAME, MENU_ICON, MENU_HERF_TYPE, MENU_HERF, MENU_ATTRIBUTE, ICON_FLAG, IS_KEEP_ALIVE, JUMP_HERF, TB_VERSION, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{menu.tenantId}, #{menu.stat}, #{menu.menuScope}, #{menu.menuCode}, #{menu.menuName}, #{menu.menuLevel}, #{menu.menuType}, #{menu.uppMenuCode}, #{menu.menuChecked}, #{menu.menuKind}, #{menu.menuVerify}, #{menu.menuDisplay}, #{menu.trCode}, #{menu.securityTrCode}, #{menu.ctrlAtti}, #{menu.bizAtti}, #{menu.acctAuthAtti}, #{menu.asacAuthAtti}, #{menu.timeAtti}, #{menu.workflowFlag}, #{menu.workflowBizType}, #{menu.isAdmin}, #{menu.isOperator}, #{menu.isUser}, #{menu.sortNo}, #{menu.subsystemCode}, #{menu.folderCode}, #{menu.bizCategoryNo}, #{menu.bizCategoryName}, #{menu.menuIcon}, #{menu.menuHerfType}, #{menu.menuHerf}, #{menu.menuAttribute}, #{menu.iconFlag}, #{menu.isKeepAlive}, #{menu.jumpHerf}, #{menu.tbVersion}, #{menu.description} )
